# Es Venture

> Short-term, high-impact projects focused on clarity, structure and momentum. Fix it. Prototype it. Structure it.

Es Venture is the personal practice of Esther — a hands-on strategist and delivery lead who helps teams cut through complexity, build momentum, and ship what matters. The site operates as a one-page "User Manual": visitors scroll through a structured narrative that explains when to reach out, what kinds of work Esther takes on, and how to start a project.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, client logos, project planner, and contact.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): Data handling and privacy terms.
- [Style Guide](/styleguide): Brand colors, typography, and component reference.
